claret.themeRole: light: primary, ring, brand-line, brand-ink, secondary-foreground, token-foreground; dark: secondary fill, primary-foreground, token-foreground

volt.themeRole: both: token fill (constant); light: secondary fill (selection, avatar); dark: primary, ring, brand-line, brand-ink, secondary-foreground

status.purpose: The daily status sentence beside the token; the page's type-led headline. CSS token --text-status.

headline.purpose: Section headings (Ranking) and the large token numeral.

rank.purpose: Row rank numeral, tabular; rank 1 in brand-ink, others in Smoke.

title.purpose: Game names in the ranking; empty-state headings at 600. CSS token --text-title.

body.purpose: Status detail line and empty-state explanations.

body-sm.purpose: Countdown, counts, labels, buttons, messages, compact status sentence.

label.purpose: Compact bar countdown and the small token numeral.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Bottom-pinned messages floating over the ranking.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Dropdown menus and the remove-game dialog.

motion.name: token-flight
motion.value: 480ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), translate + scale from the visible available token
motion.purpose: The one orchestrated motion: on vote, the token travels from the status to the voted row. Skipped under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: rank-reorder
motion.purpose: Moved rows slide to their new rank after a vote. Skipped under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: arrival-cue
motion.purpose: Shows where focus landed after a vote change or jump to your vote; static, so no reduced-motion variant.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Gutters 16px to 24px; status top 40px to 56px; row grid gains fixed 5.5rem count and 2.5rem menu columns, gap 8px to 12px. The single 42rem column holds at every width.

layout.column: max-width 42rem, left-aligned content, centered in viewport; header, status bar and messages share it

narrative.overview:
Today's action is a physical game token: a Volt disc with a claret "1" on it. It is the only bold object on the page. While the action is available it sits beside the status sentence; once used, the status keeps only its dashed empty spot; a vote places it on the row it went to, with the words "Your vote" beside it. When you vote, the token travels from the status to that row. Everything else is quiet: one left-aligned column of type and hairlines, with no cards, no tinted rows, no badges and no dashboard panels.

The page is type-led. Where you stand today is a 28px sentence ("You have today's action.", "Your action today went to "Catan"."), not a filled panel, and the suggest field sits inline under it. The ranking below is a plain hairline-divided list with large tabular rank numerals. The density is that of a working list: one row per game, counts in a fixed right-hand column, actions that disappear rather than disable once today's action is used.

The neutrals carry the brand quietly. Light theme is Paper with claret-tinted greys; dark theme is a claret Night, never neutral black. Claret (#420217) and Volt (#D0FF15) are kept exact and swap leading roles by theme, because each is about 1.2:1 against a ground of similar lightness. Accessibility to WCAG 2.2 AA is a hard floor, and contrast ratios are recorded as comments beside each token in `resources/css/app.css`.
keyCharacteristics: One bold object, the Volt action token, in three states (available, spent, placed).
A single left-aligned 42rem column on every screen size, header aligned to it.
Status as a 28px sentence, not a panel; suggest field inline beneath it.
Hairline-divided ranking rows; no cards, tints or badges.
Claret-tinted neutrals in both themes; dark ground is claret Night.
Schibsted Grotesk throughout, tabular numerals for every rank, count and countdown.
One orchestrated motion (the token flight) plus a rank-reorder slide, both skipped under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Same-Lightness Rule
rules.body: Neither brand color is ever text or a line on a ground of similar lightness: no Volt on Paper, no claret on Night. Use `brand-line`, `brand-ink` or `secondary-ink`, which resolve to the safe color per theme.

rules.name: The Role Swap Rule
rules.body: Write against semantic roles (`primary`, `secondary`, `token`, `brand-line`, `brand-ink`, `secondary-ink`), never raw hex. The theme decides which brand color plays which role; only `token` is constant.

rules.name: The One Bold Object Rule
rules.body: Volt as a fill belongs to the token (and, in dark theme, the primary button). No other surface, row or panel is filled or tinted with a brand color.

rules.name: The Edge Rule
rules.body: A line that identifies a control uses Edge (3:1 or better); Hairline is for decorative division only.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every rank, vote count, game count, character counter and countdown uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Sentence Status Rule
rules.body: Where you stand today is written as a sentence at Status size, not a label-plus-value panel.

rules.name: The Floats-Only Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "this sits above scrolling content". Rows, the status, empty states and the status bar never get one.

dos: **Do** route brand colors through `primary`, `secondary`, `token`, `brand-line`, `brand-ink` and `secondary-ink` so they swap correctly between themes.
**Do** keep the token as the only bold object: Volt fill, claret "1", 2px `brand-line` edge, in available, spent and placed states.
**Do** write today's status as a sentence at Status size (1.75rem) beside the token.
**Do** keep everything in one left-aligned 42rem column, header included, on every screen size.
**Do** divide rows and bound empty states with hairlines, and outline controls with Edge (3:1 or better).
**Do** keep vote buttons outline (40px, min 80px wide) and hide them once today's action is used.
**Do** use tabular numerals and a fixed right-hand count column; use competition ranking (1, 2, 2, 4) for ties.
**Do** pin messages to the bottom of the screen, dismissible, never auto-clearing, with both live regions always mounted.
**Do** skip the token flight and rank slide under `prefers-reduced-motion`; static cues such as the 1.6s arrival outline need no variant.
**Do** record a contrast ratio beside any new color token and hold every pairing to WCAG 2.2 AA.
donts: **Don't** use Volt as text or a line on Paper, or claret on Night (about 1.2:1).
**Don't** fill or tint rows, panels or the status with a brand color; no cards, badges or dashboard panels.
**Don't** use a neutral black or grey ground in dark theme; the ground is claret Night.
**Don't** show rows of disabled Vote buttons once today's action is used.
**Don't** add shadows to rows, the status, the status bar or empty states.
**Don't** announce the countdown; only the status sentence and its detail are live.
